item.title: Lucky x Crosse
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kotonoha
  • 発売日: 2008-06-27
  • スコア: 6.92/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ラッキー×クロス
  • 英語名: Lucky x Crosse

别名

  • Lucky Cross

あらすじ

A beautiful port town, Kitadate town, where the ocean can be seen from the top of its hill. It was almost July, and a late summer was about to arrive in this northern town.

The main character, Keito Kitami, was a freshman at Kitamizora Highschool in Kitade town. Kitamizora Highschool was a renowened school with a dorm. Since it used to be an all girl’s school, there isn’t that many boys and Keito lived in the girl’s dorm as well.

item.title: Tobu Yagi wa Sakasama no Ki no Yume o Miruka
item.description:

  • スコア: 6.69/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 飛ぶ山羊はさかさまの木の夢を見るか
  • 英語名: Tobu Yagi wa Sakasama no Ki no Yume o Miruka

别名

  • Yagiyume

あらすじ

There is an old-fashioned Western-style building on the hill by Tokyo. Main character has to substitute for his grandfather and become its landlord. He gets to know people there and even falls in love. He thinks that this calm gentle time will last forever…
